_about: Reviewed race windows (architecture stage 2, 2026-10-12): a table READ, then an outside call that waits, then the same table WRITTEN. Key: outside-call kind | the function that made the call | table | the function that wrote. See tools/race-windows.test.js.

ai|extractLeadLost|leads|markLeadLost.reason: markLeadLost is an UPDATE of one lead by its id to a fixed status; running it twice, or after another request touched the lead, gives the same result.

ai|extractSnagResolution|snags|resolveSn.reason: resolveSnag updates one snag by id to a fixed status, and everything it then decides (are any snags still open, is retention releasable) is read AFTER that write, in one database-only section.

ai|extractStockUsage|stock_items|recordS.reason: recordStockUsage subtracts relatively (quantity_on_hand = quantity_on_hand - ?), so a stock level read before the model call can never overwrite another request's change.

ai|extractStocktake|stock_items|recordSt.reason: recordStocktake re-reads the current quantity itself, after the model call and inside the write, to work out the variance; the counted figure is the authoritative new value.

ai|extractVarianceDisposition|variance_d.reason: An insert for one delivery line by its id. Risk accepted: the same disposition spoken twice at the same moment by two different people would record two (a retried request is already stopped by its idempotency key).

ai|extractWorkObservation|job_scopes|att.reason: The read before the model call (the customer's latest job) only chooses the branch. The decisions that matter, the same-work check (findOpenJobWithSameWork) and which scope to attach to, are fresh reads taken AFTER the model call, inside one database-only section that cannot interleave in an object. Risk accepted: two people describing different work for the same customer within the same second could each take the 'no job yet' branch and create two scopes, which can be merged.
